verdict.rationale: No evidence Plausible offers session replay or any user-level recording linking funnel drop-offs to individual sessions; the product is explicitly built around privacy-first, no-personal-data aggregate analytics, and community evidence confirms the founders 'refuse to adopt tracking of user flows through a website... for privacy reasons.' Funnel analysis exists (plausible-docs-5, plausible-docs-41/42) but nothing connects it to session replay.
